name: Yacht
description: Self-update spins up a watchtower container (Docker socket mounted) that pulls the mutable :latest tag and swaps Yacht's own container — no signature/Docker Content Trust.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Yacht starts watchtower:latest with the Docker socket to replace the target container, including Yacht itself.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | Yacht | https://github.com/SelfhostedPro/Yacht.git | 7ea29dc / 2025-06-30 | **Y** | N (button-triggered, JWT-authenticated, not scheduled) | **Y** | Docker Engine registry pull (delegated to Docker daemon's own HTTPS/TLS to Docker Hub — Yacht's own code performs no TLS handling and has no disable-validation flags) | N (pulls mutable `:latest` tag, no Docker Content Trust / cosign) | **none** — only a registry-digest *diff* is computed to decide "update available"; the actual replacement pulls whatever image the registry serves for the tag, unauthenticated at the app layer | server-supplied/unpinned (relies entirely on Docker Hub's registry + whatever TLS chain the Docker daemon trusts; Yacht pins nothing) | `backend/api/actions/apps.py:336-368` (`app_update`) and `:381-427` (`_update_self` / `update_self_in_background`) spin up a **`containrrr/watchtower:latest`** container with `/var/run/docker.sock` mounted and `--cleanup --run-once <container-name>`, which pulls the latest image for the target container (including **Yacht's own running container**) and replaces it — i.e. Yacht downloads-and-executes new code for itself via a delegated updater. `backend/api/utils/apps.py:330-349` (`_check_updates`) only compares `RepoDigests`, no signature check. Endpoint: `backend/api/routers/app_settings.py:86-89` (`GET /update`, JWT-authenticated) and `:92-97` (`GET /check/update`). |
